'''Minister of Information''' was a position in the [[Five Worlds]] government held by [[Denjax Teppler]]. It was noted by [[Five World Prime Minister]] [[Sadras Koyan]] that "Minister of [[Propaganda/Legends|Propaganda]]" would better fit the description of the duties attached to this post.
